spec.description: A lightweight alternative to cAdvisor for exporting metrics from Docker containers.

spec.title: Disk input 📄 Read
spec.description: Input from the block storage in bytes

spec.title: Disk output 📝 Write
spec.description: Output to the block storage in bytes

spec.title: Network received ⬇️ Download
spec.description: Input from the network in bytes

spec.title: Network transmit ⬆️ Upload
spec.description: Output to the network in bytes

spec.title: IOps
spec.description: Total block storage usage (input and output) of all containers

spec.title: Network
spec.description: Total network usage speed of all containers

spec.title: CPU total usage
spec.description: Total memory usage of all containers

spec.expr:
sort_desc(
    label_join(docker_volume_size{hostname=~"$Hostname", volumeUsage!="0", volumeContainers!=""}, "legendLabel", " - ", "volumeContainers", "volumeName")
    or 
    label_replace(docker_volume_size{hostname=~"$Hostname", volumeUsage!="0", volumeContainers=""}, "legendLabel", "$1", "volumeName", "(.*)")
)

spec.title: Memory usage
spec.description: Total memory usage of all containers

spec.title: Image updates
spec.description: Images for which updates are available

spec.expr:
sort_desc(
    label_join(docker_volume_size{hostname=~"$Hostname", volumeUsage="0", volumeContainers!=""}, "legendLabel", " - ", "volumeContainers", "volumeName")
    or 
    label_replace(docker_volume_size{hostname=~"$Hostname", volumeUsage="0", volumeContainers=""}, "legendLabel", "$1", "volumeName", "(.*)")
)
